# SDI_TCC_iNEST_Bridge

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A bridging layer that connects SDI (Software-Defined Infrastructure) with TCC and iNEST to enable dynamic reconfiguration of network and neuromorphic resources. Enables seamless co-design of communication and computation, essential for scalable in-network neuromorphic systems.
